ValidationRule.description: Federal Tax ID validation rule. Does not apply to Broker users submitting deals through the portal or the Broker API. User Profile ID = 00e80000001CNRw; nfapi user = 00e80000001CNzD
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.Id = '00534000009BfAK'), NOT($User.ProfileId='00e80000001CNRw'), NOT($User.ProfileId='00e80000001CNzD'), NOT(REGEX(Fed_Tax_ID__c ,"[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}")), NOT(REGEX(Fed_Tax_ID__c ,"[0-9]{9}")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The entered Federal Tax Id number is incorrect. Please ensure the following formatting is followed: ##-####### or ######### and that there are 9 numeric digits.
